use_backend: set the global image decoding backend to cv2, pillow, turbojpeg, or tifffile
imread: read an image from a file path or URL and return it as a numpy array
imfrombytes: decode image bytes into a numpy array using cv2, pillow, turbojpeg, or tifffile
imwrite: write a numpy array image to a local file path or remote storage backend
pillow2array: convert a PIL Image to a numpy array with configurable color flag and channel order
